quizName: Hardest Questions in Maryland Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Why is it important to keep space between your motorcycle and other vehicles?

options.text: It gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
It keeps you in one area of the lane and limits your movement.
It lets you depend on others to spot hazards.
It requires you to go faster to keep up with traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
questions.explanation: Space around your motorcycle gives you time and room to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: What is the best way to reduce the risk of head or neck injury in a crash?

options.text: Don't allow passengers on your motorcycle

questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet is the most effective way to reduce the risk of head and neck injuries in a crash.

questions.question: Which organization certifies helmets for maximum protection?
questions.explanation: For maximum protection, wear a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards.

questions.question: What should your lane position help you do?

options.text: Hide your plans from other drivers
Encourage other drivers to share your lane
See better and be seen by others

questions.correctAnswerText: See better and be seen by others
questions.explanation: Your lane position should help you see others and be seen. It should also help you avoid wind blasts, blind spots, and road hazards. It should discourage other drivers from sharing your lane and give you an escape route if danger appears.

questions.question: Which item does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: For protection, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a jacket and long pants made of strong material, sturdy boots or shoes that cover your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: What removes alcohol and its effects from your body?
questions.explanation: Only time can reduce your blood alcohol content (BAC). Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot lower your BAC or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they won't change your BAC.

questions.question: Since most crashes happen during the day, you should:

options.text: Ride on the shoulder and avoid traffic

questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. Always wear bright clothing when riding to help other drivers see you, even during the day.

questions.question: What benefit do gloves provide?

options.text: They make motorcycle control difficult and should be avoided
They help other drivers identify you
They give you a better grip on the handlebars

questions.correctAnswerText: They give you a better grip on the handlebars
questions.explanation: Gloves give you a better grip on your motorcycle's handlebars. They also protect your hands if you crash.

questions.question: What should you do with shoelaces when riding?
questions.explanation: Tuck shoelaces securely so they don't catch on your motorcycle.

questions.question: Where should you find information about your specific motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who rides a different motorcycle
A television show about motorcycle riding

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you're riding a borrowed motorcycle.

questions.question: What is the most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet that is fastened securely is the best way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: Which surface gives a motorcycle the best traction?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces create poor traction. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers are all more dangerous than dry pavement for motorcycles.

questions.question: Which surface provides the best traction for a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces create poor traction. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers are all more dangerous than dry pavement for motorcycles.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to increase your speed.
Only when there is heavy traffic.
Every time you plan to change lanes.
Only when it is dark outside.

questions.correctAnswerText: Every time you plan to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal whenever you plan to turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is nearby.

questions.question: Which color helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear orange, red, yellow, or green clothing when riding. These bright colors make you easier to see at any time of day.

questions.question: What should you look for in a helmet to get the best protection?

options.text: It meets Department of Transportation guidelines.
It is in your favorite color.

questions.correctAnswerText: It meets Department of Transportation guidelines.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around and have no defects.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Safe motorcycle gear includes a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves.

questions.question: Why are signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: They serve little purpose because motorcycles are small.
They alert other drivers to what you plan to do.
They should not be used if no vehicles are nearby.
They are more complicated than signals on a car.

questions.correctAnswerText: They alert other drivers to what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: As a motorcyclist, you are more vulnerable. Always use turn signals to alert others to your plans. Use them every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is nearby.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing a DOT-approved helmet?

options.text: It does not limit side vision.
It can greatly reduce head injury severity.
It makes it easier to control your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can greatly reduce head injury severity.
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet does not restrict your vision to the sides.

questions.question: What is an important purpose of clothing when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It should be loose enough to flap in the wind.
It should leave your arms and legs uncovered.
You should not wear a jacket in warm weather.
It can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: The right clothing provides protection in a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly so it does not flap in the wind, but loose enough so you can move freely.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Be part of your normal driving routine.
Be avoided because they distract you.
Be avoided because other drivers will see you.
Only be done in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your normal driving routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to know what is behind you. Regular mirror checks keep you safe and should be part of how you normally scan the road.

questions.question: Your body can only remove alcohol through:
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Only be done on long trips.
Be part of your normal scanning routine.
Not be helpful since you cannot change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your normal scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of normal driving. Also check mirrors before changing lanes, when stopping at an intersection, and before slowing down.

questions.question: Proper motorcycle clothing should:

options.text: Cover your arms and legs completely.
Cover your arms but leave your legs exposed.
Cover your legs but leave your arms exposed.
Be whatever is most comfortable, regardless of safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely to protect yourself while riding.

questions.question: Goggles will:

options.text: Work as well as a face shield.
Give the same protection as a windshield.

questions.explanation: Goggles protect only your eyes, not the rest of your face. A face shield protects your whole face and is better than goggles. A windshield does not provide enough protection.
